cohort: Women who had features of heart failure in the last 6 weeks of pregnancy or 5 months postpartum, with absence of other identifiable causes of heart failure or absence of features of heart failure prior to the last month of pregnancy and absence of left ventricular dysfunction prior to this, with a mean age of 31 years, and mostly multigravid, in the Department of Obstetrics and Gyneacology Government Medical College Srinagar.
finding: Maternal outcome was poor in cases with decreased ejection fraction and severe symptoms.
